UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile in the Aces Hockey Hub application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

jerseyNumber.description: Optional jersey number of the user.

role.description: The administrative role of the user.

playerType.description: The functional role of the user on the team.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Represents a hockey match, played or upcoming.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Match entity.

dateTime.description: Date and time of the match.

location.description: Location where the match will be held.

isPlayed.description: Indicates if the match has been played and a result has been recorded.

team2Score.description: Final score for the opponent team.

scorers.description: An array of objects detailing each goal scored by the home team.

goal.description: The user ID of the player who scored the goal.

assist.description: The user ID of the player who assisted on the goal.

lineup.description: Stores the saved lineup for the match, with positions as keys (e.g., LK1, C1) and denormalized player data as values.

goalieId.description: The user ID of the goalie who played in the match.

goalieSaves.description: Number of saves made by the goalie in the match.

goalieShotsAgainst.description: Number of shots against the goalie in the match.

SkaterStats.title: SkaterStats
SkaterStats.description: Represents the statistics of a skater, categorized by season, playoff, and all-time history.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SkaterStats entity.

seasonGoals.description: Number of goals scored by the player in the current regular season.

seasonAssists.description: Number of assists made by the player in the current regular season.

seasonGamesPlayed.description: Number of games played by the player in the current regular season.

playoffGoals.description: Number of goals scored by the player in the current playoffs.

playoffAssists.description: Number of assists made by the player in the current playoffs.

playoffGamesPlayed.description: Number of games played by the player in the current playoffs.

historicalGoals.description: Total number of goals scored by the player in their career.

historicalAssists.description: Total number of assists made by the player in their career.

historicalGamesPlayed.description: Total number of games played by the player in their career.

GoalieStats.title: GoalieStats
GoalieStats.description: Represents the statistics of a goalie, categorized by season, playoff, and all-time history.

Attendance.title: Attendance
Attendance.description: Represents a user's attendance status for a specific match.

note.description: An optional note from the user about their attendance.

AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description: Stores global application settings for the league.

isPlayoffEnabled.description: Controls whether the playoff view is enabled for all users.

isScoringInPlayoffMode.description: Controls whether player stats tracking is in 'play-off' mode, which uses a separate counter.

playoffSeries.description: An array of objects representing playoff series.

firestore.reasoning:
Based on the requirements, the Firestore data structure is designed to prioritize security, scalability, and ease of maintenance. The core principle is Authorization Independence, achieved through denormalization where necessary, ensuring security rules are robust and efficient. The structure segregates data based on access needs and applies consistent access modeling patterns.

User profiles are stored in a private collection, accessible only to the authenticated user. PlayerStats are stored as a subcollection under user profiles to model the 1:1 relationship, ensuring that stats can only be accessed by the user themselves.

Matches are stored in a separate collection, assumably accessible to all users. If match visibility were to change (e.g. only accessible to players), a membership map could be added to the `Match` entity to define access.

This design supports the QAPs (Rules are not filters) principle by ensuring that listing operations can be secured effectively. Since user profile data is private and matches are public, filtering isn't a primary concern at this stage of the design. If more complex list operations become necessary (e.g., listing matches by a specific team), indexing strategies can be applied without compromising security.

Authorization Independence is achieved by avoiding `get()` calls in security rules. Access to user profiles is based on `request.auth.uid` matching the `userId` in the path. Since the PlayerStats collection is nested under the UserProfile, access is implicitly controlled by the UserProfile access rules.
